description: The change feed: every new prop, line move, price move and status change after a cursor, oldest first. Use it to keep up with the market without rereading the board. Start with since "now" (no rows, just the cursor to poll from) or 0 (the last 24 hours), then pass back meta.next_cursor each time. Optional league filter.

league.description: League code, for example NBA, NFL, NHL, MLB, NCAAB, NCAAF.

since.description: Cursor from a previous call's meta.next_cursor; "now" to start from this moment with no backlog; 0 or empty for the last 24 hours.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Saved so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: recent_changes
